claim: Low-cost conveyor integration requires stable induction and spacing control; otherwise parcel timing and presentation drive jams, no-reads, and robot intervention misses.
PLC/WCS integration maturity is constrained by the software-and-controls handshake and fault-recovery loop, not only by electronics availability.
Vision processing compute maturity depends on real-time low-cost compute integration, SDK/runtime coupling, thermal design, and latency control.
Robot base maturity depends on repeatable installation, alignment, anchoring, vibration checking, and commissioning, not only on steel availability.
Suction cup array maturity depends on contact qualification across variable parcel surfaces, not only elastomer feedstock availability.
Vacuum valve and blow-off maturity depends on dynamic timing, contamination tolerance, leakage handling, and robot-motion synchronization.
